gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho has a hulking lowercase, like thick chalk pressed hard, with an e left gaping at its terminal; Eater scratches thin and dark above it. Over a full page, it would feel steady and easy to follow.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-vithk: Expressive lines run through Funnel Display, every stroke traced as if with one stylus. Funnel Display is best at loud, wiry shapes, while Noto Sans Vithkuqi is best at open, quiet text with a barely-there step up to capitals.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-tu: Ornate letters meet chunky ones here. Almendra Display does its best work with a literary, tall-x-height flourish, while Noto Sans Old Turkic keeps its open-mouthed curves clear and approachable.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Futuristic tile-like glyphs from Audiowide sit over Noto Sans Ol Chiki, whose words read as solid blocks with curve tails held well back. Size the body up a touch.
gen-flavors-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi is outsized in its lowercase, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Flavors brings whimsy at big, short sizes, its diagonals as hefty as its stems, so let it carry the headline alone.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-yi: Eater's thin strokes and weighty stems spread out with wide gaps and short ascenders, giving a dark, aggressive start. Noto Sans Yi follows with a deep midsection and rounds left unsealed, a modern sans that steadies the page.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Autour One draws a bold, stencil-brush line with a clear channel leading into each round letter and hardly any step down from capitals. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square rises tall beneath it, crisp and approachable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-traditiona: Wire-bent and loud, Funnel Display keeps every stroke at one width and its c tips well apart. It is best at expressive display, while Noto Traditional Nushu does better with broad-nibbed, filled bowls.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic sits tight between x-height and cap height, with curve endings kept well apart, under Audiowide's tile-like tech glyphs. Reading it feels smooth and businesslike.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Literary and ornate, Almendra Display lets its letters stay open with a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Lydian then keeps capitals barely above lowercase, so reading it for pages feels approachable and neutral.
